fact.subject: Hirocon
fact.text: Merlin explains that his friend Hirocon spread the Tetrads across time and space for a hero to assemble.

evidence.quote:
Merlin: Long ago I 
had a good friend from a faraway planet. His name was Hirocon. He spread the 
Tetrads across time and space so that only a hero could find them. When we last 
spoke, he asked me to watch over such a hero in his journey someday. That hero 
was you, Sir Mike, and that day has come. You must now collect the last Tetrad 
and put them all together. The fate of Hirocon's race rests on you.
